forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter the email address of your account. We'll send you a link to renew your password; the link opens the app.
forgot.note: The link works once and is valid for a short time. If you signed in with Apple or Google, you don't need a password.

forgot.sentHint: If the email hasn't arrived, check your junk folder.

body.body: Add your height and 1–3 full-length photos; we'll show products and suggestions as they look on you.

body.weightInvalid: Enter a weight between 30 and 250 kg, or leave it empty.

permission.photosDeniedBody: Turn photo access on in Settings, or take the photo with your camera.
